<!-- uv-active-slice: recipe-entrypoint-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: recipe-entrypoint-retirement -->

## Goal

Execute the bounded D-070 `recipe-entrypoint-retirement` slice: retire recipe-backed public project creation/catalog entrypoints now that supported New Project creation is owned by Production Directions, while preserving old-project read/import compatibility and the internal Recipe Registry still needed by later compatibility slices.

## Changes

- removed `frontend/lib/recipesApi.ts`;
- removed `projectsApi#createUVProject` and `CreateProjectInput`;
- unmounted `/api/uv/recipes`;
- retired recipe-backed public `POST /api/uv/projects`;
- retired generic project PATCH `recipe_id` rebinding;
- preserved project list/get/archive/import and non-recipe metadata updates;
- preserved modern `GET /api/uv/projects/studio/directions` + `POST /api/uv/projects/studio` creation authority;
- retained internal Recipe Registry compatibility for `/execution-plan`, Product Orchestrator and later retirement slices;
- migrated API/real-media/browser compatibility fixtures to explicit test-only ProjectStore seeding instead of resurrecting retired public entrypoints;
- synchronized the D-070 legacy-surface inventory and lifecycle context.

## Verification

Lifecycle-closed BASE is `1068694fac69eb02ff6e0651855c875c532e31a7`.

Material implementation head `2344667deada22983e362d468db084ed5cede797` passed CI #4804 with all five permanent checks SUCCESS, including API integration, Stage4A real-media and browser Product Truth on Ubuntu and Windows.

Current review head is `6218437f78d6d8b842cda1d01f8c675147446513`. The delta from the green implementation head is context-only lifecycle refreeze (`draft -> review`); runtime/tests/product behavior are unchanged.

The historical cross-workspace fallback browser test remains explicitly filtered by `e2e/run_browser_e2e.py` and replaced by product-owned outcomes; it is not an active acceptance caller of the retired create route.

This review head must receive the repository-required fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review under `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` v1.0 and all five permanent checks before merge.

## Architecture impact

This removes obsolete public composition entrypoints; it does not replace Recipe Registry internals or alter canonical Project Store, Production Direction, Production Semantic Core, Timeline, Generation, Capability/D-017 or Agent authorities. Modern project creation remains `Production Direction -> Studio Project`.

## Known limitations

This slice does not retire `/execution-plan`, Product Orchestrator, the legacy `/projects/{id}` workflow, Stage8 state/runtime/panels or the historical compatibility reader. Those remain separate D-070 slices.

## Next task

Fresh exact BASE/HEAD semantic review -> validate findings -> exact-head permanent CI -> merge verified HEAD -> mandatory D-038 closure to `idle` -> `execution-plan-retirement`.
